subject.title: fix(telegram): links with '&' query params drop parameters when tapped (#102162) [AI-assisted]

question: Should this PR keep raw ampersands in every Telegram link href, or should the fix be scoped to bare auto-linked URLs until live Telegram proof supports the broader behavior?
rationale: The linked issue treats labeled Markdown links as an unaffected workaround, while this diff changes labeled-link href output too and the external Telegram client behavior is not proven by formatter output alone.

options.title: Scope to bare auto-links
options.body: Preserve the existing escaped href behavior for labeled Markdown links unless live Telegram proof shows they need the same raw-ampersand treatment.

options.title: Accept broad href change with proof
options.body: Keep the all-link raw-href behavior only after live Telegram proof covers both bare and labeled multi-parameter links.

options.title: Choose a sibling candidate
options.body: Pause this PR if another open candidate becomes the proven canonical fix for the linked Telegram issue.

recommendation.title: Scope to bare auto-links
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing escaped href behavior for labeled Markdown links unless live Telegram proof shows they need the same raw-ampersand treatment.
